stem: Omar has 18 postage stamps. Each stamp is worth either 50 cents or 20 cents, and the stamps are worth \$6.60 in all. How many 50-cent stamps does Omar have?
solution: Let \(f\) and \(t\) be the numbers of 50-cent and 20-cent stamps: \(f + t = 18\) and \(0.50f + 0.20t = 6.60\).
verify:
f, t = symbols('f t')
sol = solve([f + t - 18, Rational(1, 2)*f + Rational(1, 5)*t - Rational(33, 5)], [f, t])
assert sol == {f: 10, t: 8}
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == [sol[f]]
